- Elevate your everyday elegance with these stunning gold-plated round stud earrings, designed with a unique square shimmer stone at the center. Surrounded by a sparkling CZ-studded halo, these earrings blend minimal style with luxurious detail, making them perfect for both daily wear and special occasions.
- Lightweight and comfortable, they pair beautifully with ethnic, Western, and Indo-western outfits. The refined gold finish and lustrous central stone add sophistication to any look, making these studs a versatile must-have in your jewelry collection.
